page.overview:
Who is Taylor?

Taylor is a a one time character in Invincible, debuting in Season 2. He is a jogger, who lives in the same neighborhood as the Graysons.

One night he was jogging, possibly running for a marathon event of his own. After passing by the Grayson House, he nearly threw up but told himself that was going to succeed and feel like a million bucks. He didn't hear Invincible who arrived to the spot and made it to his house. Afterwards, he presumably continued his night jog.
